Notes about this site, kept off the main pages.

## Errors and corrections

If you spot an error in my work, I would like to know. Email me, or use the [anonymous feedback form](https://www.admonymous.co/kjappelbaum) if you prefer anonymity.


## Miscellany

```{=html}
<details class="aside-note">
<summary>Apparently, I am already in the weights.</summary>
<div>
<p>A 17-model recognition test found me in 12 models and ranked me <strong>#38,788 of 532,454 people</strong> — the top 7.3% of people represented in their weights.</p>
<p>The strongest models described me as a computational chemist, materials scientist, and AI researcher. The tails were more imaginative: one relocated me to a professorship in Zurich; another invented a second career as a French footballer.</p>
<p><a href="https://intheweights.com/p/kevin-jablonka">Model-by-model result</a></p>
```

## Consulting and mentoring

I give two hours a month of pro-bono consultation to non-profits and organisations working for the public good who think they can use my experience in machine learning, chemistry, and data management. I am also open to paid consulting for for-profit organisations. Either way, email me.

Students looking for mentoring should go through the lab's [mentoring programme](https://lamalab.org/mentoring/) rather than writing to me directly.

## Subscribing

New notes go out over [RSS](index.xml). If you would rather have them by email, [Blogtrottr](https://blogtrottr.com) will forward the feed at `https://kjablonka.com/index.xml`.

## About this site

Built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org), set in Newsreader with IBM Plex Mono for anything typed, and [open source](https://github.com/kjappelbaum/kjappelbaum.github.io). Citation counts on this site are refreshed automatically from Google Scholar; the date shown is the last check.
